baslik: How does a nuclear power plant make electricity? ⚛️ #shorts
aciklama:
Energy Sources, episode 4: the atom. Fission, the chain reaction and control rods, fuel pellet, rod and assembly, pressure vessel and steam generator, turbine, safety and Akkuyu. Model: VVER-1200 pressurised water reactor (3212 MWt, about 1200 MWe). Akkuyu: 4 units, 4800 MW in total.

Narration uses an AI voice clone; visuals are code-generated 3D animation; music is an original AI-generated track.
